name: Crypto (Septeo Solutions Immobilier)
positioning: The incumbent French property administration suite — installed across a large share of professional syndic and gérance portfolios.
description: Crypto, part of Septeo's real estate division, covers syndic, gérance and transaction for French property administrators: per-building and mandant accounting, calls for funds, assemblies, lease and receipt management, and extranets for co-owners, owners and tenants.
real_estate_use: It is the system of record in many established French administration de biens firms, chosen for accounting depth rather than for interface. Its centre of gravity is the regulated ledger: separate accounts per copropriété, mandant funds kept distinct from the firm's own money, and the reporting a comptable and an auditor expect.
features: Syndic accounting per building with regulatory account structures
Gérance with mandant accounting and owner reddition de comptes
Calls for funds, budgets and assembly management

use_cases.job: Keep regulated per-building accounts that satisfy an auditor
Produce owner reddition de comptes from mandant accounting rather than a spreadsheet
